what: Pre-flight halt 2 (not the primary checkout) is worded for agent worktrees, but a human sibling worktree where the session itself created the branch also fails the literal test; the loop had to decide it did not apply.
tell: session runs in a sibling worktree while another session owns the primary checkout; halt 2 would force switching the other session's checkout
proposed_change: Define halt 2 on agent-worktree location (e.g. under .agents/worktrees) or on the session having created the branch, not on being the first git worktree list entry.
